subject: maths

topics.topic: Number: Numbers and the number system
covers: Count, read and write numerals to 20, and recite numbers in order.
Count objects up to 20 and know the number does not change when they are rearranged.
Count on in tens and in twos, and see that odd and even numbers alternate.
Split two-digit numbers into tens and ones, and put them back together.
Order numbers to at least 20 on a number line and use ordinal numbers.
Say the number that is 1 or 10 more or less than a number up to 30.
Compare two numbers with more, less and the = sign, and name a number between them.
Estimate small groups that can be checked by counting.
Double single-digit numbers and find halves of even numbers up to 10.
Share objects into two equal groups and see which numbers can be shared evenly.
Find halves of small numbers and shapes by folding, and say which shapes are halved.
Find halves, thirds, quarters and tenths of shapes and whole numbers.

gaps: Public outline gives examples only, not the full Stage 1 list for Number.
